{{Quote|At the end of our seventh day, with slaves running low, we penetrated the Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BOS" />}}
The '''Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla''' was an ancient sacred tomb on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. It contained the [[Holocron of King Nakgru]], various [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemic]] [[Sith scroll/Legends|scrolls]] and the preserved body of a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]].<ref name="BOS" />

The tomb had lain undisturbed for more than ten thousand years when [[Sorzus Syn]] pillaged it with a few Sith [[Grotthu|slaves]]<ref name="BOS" /> in [[6899 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> It was protected by packs of [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] and the antechamber contained stone gargoyles that would turn to life in the presence of intruders.<ref name="BOS" />
